text: ひとから　もらった　ポケモンは　はやく　そだつしね！

structure.jp: ひとから　もらった　ポケモンは
structure.en: Pokémon you got from other people

structure.jp: はやく　そだつしね！

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a verb adds one more reason on top of what was already said, like 'and what's more'. そだつし = 'and besides, they grow'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひとから　もらった　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A short phrase ending in a verb sits in front of a noun and describes it. ひとから　もらった　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that you got from someone'.
